name: Mass Deleter
summary: Delete chapters or episodes in bulk, from a comic or from one user's uploads.

scripts.title: Delete chapters or episodes
scripts.summary: Anything left blank gets asked in the console. Deleting always needs DELETE typed in the console.

fields.label: Comic or anime
fields.hint: Paste its ComicK link or type the slug.

fields.label: User
fields.hint: Their profile link, or just the user id.

fields.label: Language
fields.hint: A language code, or all. Blank asks in the console.

fields.label: Only from comic
fields.hint: A slug or link, to keep to one comic's chapters.

fields.label: Which numbers
fields.hint: Blank lists them in the console first and asks there.

fields.label: Reason
fields.hint: Reviewers and the audit log see this.

fields.label: Dry run, delete nothing
fields.hint: Go through every check and list what would be deleted, without deleting anything.
